stage1.title: Hello there.
stage1.subtitle: Tell us your name. We'll tell you the AI Global story while you climb.

pre.title: Meet AI Global
pre.body:
A community of senior people who treat AI as a craft, not a horoscope. Built with MIT Professional Education. Mission: open systems, practical AI, clear stewardship.

Every quarter the whole community picks one domain and ships real work together. Q1 2026 is marketing — GloLabs Vol 1 just dropped, six peer-reviewed case studies covering workshop pipelines, multimedia, community growth, content systems and ambassador loops.

Four programs you'll meet:
• GloLabs — peer-reviewed case-study library, quarterly
• GloGames — interactive AI lessons (try one in Stage 4)
• SPC — four hands-on governance courses
• Projects — VideoGlo · Ambassador · AI.MRKT (teaching AI in underserved communities) · AI 2027 (frontier-AI risk → enforceable law)

Volunteer in any of them. 11K+ taught · 200+ upskilled · 1K+ members in 4 weeks · 80%+ weekly active. The energy is real.

Now — 100 m to feel the climb. Falling is fine; it's just a feel.

stage1.ctaHint: 100 m. We'll hint the first few holds.

stage2.title: Your first intro
stage2.subtitle: One line you'd actually post in Discord.

pre.title: The Discord, briefly
pre.body: The community lives on a Discord server called AI Global. First stop is #👋introduce-yourself — light format: name, country, role, what you're here for. Pick a lane below and we'll draft a starter line in your name. Shuffle for variety, or write your own.

stage2.ctaHint: Same wall, no hints this time. You've got this.

outcome.winBody: Your intro is ready to post. Drop it into #👋introduce-yourself — people there are quick to ❤️ and reply.
outcome.failBody: The intro is still ready — post it anyway, then come back for another go. Falling is part of the climb.

stage3.title: Find your buddy
stage3.subtitle: The longer post. We'll format it for you.

pre.title: How buddies work
pre.body: #🤝find-a-buddy has a specific format — location, role, what you'd teach, what you want to learn. Fill the form below and we'll produce a copy-paste-ready post. Then climb as high as you can.

stage3.ctaHint: No target. Just go as high as you can.

outcome.posterBody: Your buddy post is ready. Drop it in #find-a-buddy — you'll have replies by morning.
outcome.lovedPrompt: Optional — one line about what hooked you. Lives on the poster.
outcome.next: One more game in Stage 4 — how a neural net actually learns.

stage4.title: One more game
stage4.subtitle: How a neural net actually learns.
stage4.body: GloGames' first release. Six floors covering Inputs → Weights → Neurons → Activation → Loss → the learning loop. Quietly excellent. About ten minutes if you're curious.
